text: N262568March 23, 2015CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:356CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.30.3053Ms. Oralia Ruiz Sole Technology Inc,26921 Fuerte DriveLake Forest, CA  92630         RE:	The tariff classification of a men’s knit pullover from China.    Dear Ms. Ruiz:In your letter dated February 27, 2015, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  The sample provided will be returned.The submitted sample, Style A, is a men’s pullover garment constructed from 100% polyester, finely knit fleece fabric that is napped on the inside and outside surfaces.  The fabric measures 38 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction. The garment is cut and sewn and features a self-fabric hood with a drawstring; a partial front opening with a zippered closure; a patch pocket on the left chest, which is secured by a snap closure; long sleeves with a button closure at the vent and single button closures on the cuffs; a pouch pocket below the waist; and a curved, hemmed bottom and a tail. You suggest classification of the garment in subheading 6110.30.3059, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of man-made fibers: other: other: other: women’s or girls’:  other. The documentation submitted states that the gender of the merchandise is men’s.You also suggest classification of the garment in subheading 6114.30.3060, HTSUS, which provides for other garments, knitted or crocheted: of man-made fibers: other, other: men’s or boys’. The garment is more specifically provided for in heading 6110 as a pullover.  Consequently, the  applicable subheading for Style A will be 6110.30.3053, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of man-made fibers: other: other: other: other: men’s or boys’: other. The rate of duty is 32% ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Rosemarie Hayward via e-mail at rosemariecasey.hayward@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerDirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of a men’s knit pullover from China.
